steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Concept: Data analysis means identifying patterns, trends, and relationships in your data. It involves describing what the data shows, calculating statistics, and explaining the geographical reasons behind the patterns you find. | Definition: The IQR measures the spread of the middle 50% of data, eliminating the influence of outliers. It is calculated as Q3 − Q1, where Q1 is the 25th percentile and Q3 is the 75th percentile. | Definition: Spearman's Rank measures the strength and direction of the relationship between two variables. It produces a value between -1 and +1.
